article_title: Body of US climber Mallory Geis found after Broad Peak avalanche

tasks.prompt: What is the main development reported in the article?
options: Broad Peak was closed permanently to climbers
US climber Mallory Geis’s body was found as rescuers searched after an avalanche
All members of the expedition were rescued alive
A new climbing record was set on Broad Peak
tasks.correct_answer: US climber Mallory Geis’s body was found as rescuers searched after an avalanche
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההתפתחות המרכזית היא איתור גופתה של המטפסת האמריקאית מלורי גייס במהלך החיפושים אחרי המפולת.

tasks.prompt: Where did the avalanche strike the expedition?
options: On Broad Peak in Pakistan’s Karakoram range
At Everest base camp in Nepal
On a ski slope in the United States
Near the summit of Mont Blanc in France
tasks.correct_answer: On Broad Peak in Pakistan’s Karakoram range
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המפולת אירעה ב־Broad Peak שברכס קרקוראם בפקיסטן.

options: The expedition refused to use trackers
The mountain had no established climbing route
Harsh weather and limited helicopter access hampered searches
Officials stopped all aerial and ground searches immediately
tasks.correct_answer: Harsh weather and limited helicopter access hampered searches
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מזג האוויר הקשה והזמינות המוגבלת של מסוקים בפקיסטן עיכבו את פעולות החיפוש והחילוץ.

tasks.prompt: What does “remains” mean in the report?
options: Equipment left at base camp
The body of a person who has died
Food supplies for the expedition
Tracks visible in the snow
tasks.correct_answer: The body of a person who has died
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בכתבת אסון, remains משמשת כמילה מכבדת לגופתו או שרידיו של אדם שמת.

tasks.prompt: If weather is “hampering” rescuers, what is it doing?
options: Making their work more difficult or slowing it down
Guaranteeing them a safe route
Identifying the missing climbers
Allowing helicopters to fly continuously
tasks.correct_answer: Making their work more difficult or slowing it down
tasks.explanation_hebrew: hampering פירושו מעכב או מקשה על התקדמות הפעולה.

tasks.prompt: The article calls Nirmal Purja a “renowned” mountaineer. What does “renowned” mean?
options: Recently certified but unknown
Injured before the expedition began
Famous and highly regarded
Unwilling to climb without a guide
tasks.explanation_hebrew: renowned מתאר אדם מפורסם ומוערך מאוד בתחום שלו.

tasks.prompt: Why were tracker data and aerial searches important in this rescue? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהאזור גבוה, מסוכן וקשה לגישה, ולכן נתוני GPS וצילומי אוויר יכולים לצמצם את אזור החיפוש ולספק רמזים על מיקום ותנועה.
expected_points: The avalanche occurred high on a remote mountain
Trackers could indicate sudden altitude changes or movement
Drones or helicopters could survey terrain too dangerous for immediate ground access

tasks.prompt: Write an 80–110 word summary covering the avalanche, Mallory Geis, the continuing search, and the rescue difficulties.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את האירוע ב־Broad Peak, איתור גופתה של גייס, נעדרים נוספים והקשיים שנגרמו ממזג האוויר והגישה המוגבלת.
expected_points: An avalanche struck an international climbing expedition on Broad Peak
The remains of US climber Mallory Geis were found
Other expedition members were still being located or identified
Weather, altitude and limited aerial access complicated the operation

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference in meaning between “located”, “identified”, and “recovered” in the rescue report.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין מציאת המיקום, קביעת הזהות, והבאת האדם או הגופה מן ההר למקום בטוח.
expected_points: Located means found at a particular place
Identified means officials established who the person was
Recovered means rescuers physically brought the person or remains from the site
The stages may occur at different times during a difficult operation

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining why officials had to clarify early casualty figures.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין תנאי תקשורת וחילוץ קשים, דיווחים ראשוניים משתנים, והצורך להמתין לאימות רשמי לפני קביעה סופית.
expected_points: Initial information from a remote disaster site can be incomplete
Communication and visual confirmation were difficult
Officials corrected or clarified figures after receiving better information
Reliable reporting requires distinguishing confirmed facts from preliminary reports
